blocks.text: A fuming Dennis Trillo called out an event styling business for using a newspaper featuring a headline about his wife, actress Jennylyn Mercado, from when she suffered abuse as a child as part of its party decorations. The party supplier put up what appeared to be a sari-sari store-themed setup that included posters and newspapers, as seen in the screenshot shared by the actor on his Facebook page on Thursday, Nov. 5. One of the newspapers featured a headline accompanied by a photo of a young Mercado with bruises around her eyes after suffering physical abuse at the hands of her […]...
